title: AtScale aggregates: lifecycle
description: When AtScale created, rebuilt and deactivated aggregates, why, and how many each catalog and model has.

list.name: enginedb
list.label: Engine database
list.description: PostgreSQL data source on the AtScale database of one instance, for the prediction reports. Pick the instance you look at.

panels.title: Active aggregates
panels.description: Aggregates that AtScale can use for queries now (latest poll of the aggregates API).

targets.expr: sum(atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})

panels.title: Rows in aggregate tables
panels.description: Rows in all active aggregate tables.

targets.expr: sum(atscale_aggregate_rows_total{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})

panels.title: Not used by any query yet
panels.description: Active aggregates whose query count (AtScale queryUtilization) is 0. AtScale deactivates aggregates that stay unused for the configured number of days (setting aggregates.maintenance.zeroUtilizationTTL, default 45).

targets.expr: sum(atscale_aggregates_unused{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})

panels.title: Models with aggregates
panels.description: Models that have at least one active aggregate.

targets.expr: count(count by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"}))

panels.title: User-defined aggregates
panels.description: Aggregates defined in the model (SML) or created by a user. AtScale creates all other aggregates itself.

targets.expr: sum(atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",type="user_defined"})

panels.title: Exporter up
panels.description: 1 = the last poll of every selected AtScale instance succeeded. Always shows the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: min(atscale_aggregates_exporter_up{env=~"$env"})

panels.title: Active aggregates per catalog and model
panels.description: Demand: created because a user query had no matching aggregate. Predicted: created from the query history. User-defined: defined in the model (SML) or created by a user. Not used yet: no query has used the aggregate.

targets.expr: sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})
sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",subtype="demand_defined"})
sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",subtype="prediction_defined"})
sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",type="user_defined"})
sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregates_unused{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})
sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregate_rows_total{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})

panels.title: Aggregates per catalog and why they exist
panels.description: Active aggregates per instance and catalog, split by subtype (why AtScale created them). The table on the left splits them by model.

targets.expr: label_join(sum by (env, catalog, subtype) (atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"}), "catalog_in_env", " / ", "env", "catalog")

panels.title: Active aggregates over time
panels.description: Number of active aggregates per model, as the exporter saw it on each poll.

targets.expr: sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregates{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})

panels.title: Rows in aggregate tables over time
panels.description: Rows in all active aggregate tables per model.

targets.expr: sum by (env, catalog, model) (atscale_aggregate_rows_total{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})

panels.title: Created
panels.description: Aggregates that became active for the first time in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time($event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" | action="created" [$__range]))

panels.title: Rebuilt
panels.description: Aggregates that got a new active instance (a new table) in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time($event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" | action="rebuilt" [$__range]))

panels.title: Deactivated
panels.description: Aggregates that AtScale stopped using in the selected range. AtScale drops the table later (setting aggregates.invalid.removalAge, default 2 days).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time($event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" | action="deactivated" [$__range]))

panels.title: Events over time
panels.description: Lifecycle events per 10 minutes (or wider on long ranges), from the exporter's event log. A bar appears when its interval has ended.

targets.expr: sum by (action) (count_over_time($event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Why created
panels.description: query_demand: a user query had no matching aggregate. prediction: predicted from the query history. user_defined_in_model: defined in the model (SML). user_defined_manual: created by a user.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time($event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" | action="created" [$__range]))

panels.title: Why rebuilt
panels.description: scheduled_batch: a build schedule ran shortly before. on_demand_batch: a batch build started by the API, the UI or a trigger file. query_demand: built again outside a batch because a query needed it. full or incremental: from the aggregate definition. AtScale stores no trigger, so the exporter derives it.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time($event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" | action="rebuilt" [$__range]))

panels.title: Why deactivated
panels.description: Classified from AtScale's status message of the last instance. unused: not used for the configured number of days. replaced_by_rebuild: a batch build replaced it. model_changed: the model no longer matches the aggregate. removed_by_user: deleted in the UI or API. deleted_no_reason_logged: AtScale deleted it without an earlier status that names a reason.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time($event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model" | action="deactivated" [$__range]))

panels.title: Event log
panels.description: One row per lifecycle event. Time is when AtScale created or built the aggregate; for deactivations it is when the exporter saw the change. Click an aggregate ID to see its full history in the engine log.

targets.expr: $event_selector |= "atscale_aggregate" | json | env=~"$env" | catalog=~"$catalog" | model=~"$model"

value.title: History of this aggregate in the engine log

panels.title: Status history from the engine log (also before the exporter ran)

options.content: AtScale writes one engine log line for each status change of an aggregate instance: `new` → `inprogress` (build) → `done` → `active`, and later `invalid` (deactivated, with the reason) → `deleted` (table dropped). These panels read those lines, so they show the history as far back as the log store keeps it. The catalog and model names come from the exporter; IDs that the exporter does not know stay as IDs.

panels.title: Status changes over time
panels.description: Instance status changes per 10 minutes (or wider on long ranges), from the engine log. A bar appears when its interval has ended. active = an aggregate became usable (new or rebuilt). invalid = deactivated. deleted = table dropped.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time($engine_selector |= "status changed to" | regexp `Aggregate instance (?P<instance_id>[0-9a-f-]{36}) status changed to "(?P<status>\w+)"\.\s*(?P<message>.*?)\s*\(aggDefId=(?P<aggregate_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})\)` | regexp `projectId=(?P<catalog_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})` | regexp `cubeId=(?P<model_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Why deactivated or failed (engine log)
panels.description: The status message of every change to invalid (deactivated) or failed (build failed), as the engine logged it. This is the reason. A table drop (deleted) without an earlier invalid line has no logged reason.

targets.expr: sum by (status, message) (count_over_time($engine_selector |= "status changed to" | regexp `Aggregate instance (?P<instance_id>[0-9a-f-]{36}) status changed to "(?P<status>\w+)"\.\s*(?P<message>.*?)\s*\(aggDefId=(?P<aggregate_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})\)` | regexp `projectId=(?P<catalog_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})` | regexp `cubeId=(?P<model_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})` | status=~"invalid|failed" | label_format message=`{{ if .message }}{{ regexReplaceAll "[0-9a-f-]{36}" .message "<id>" }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Status changes
panels.description: Every status change of an aggregate instance. Message is the reason AtScale gives (empty for build steps). Filter a column with the funnel icon, or click an aggregate ID for its full history.

targets.expr: $engine_selector |= "status changed to" | regexp `Aggregate instance (?P<instance_id>[0-9a-f-]{36}) status changed to "(?P<status>\w+)"\.\s*(?P<message>.*?)\s*\(aggDefId=(?P<aggregate_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})\)` | regexp `projectId=(?P<catalog_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})` | regexp `cubeId=(?P<model_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})` | label_format message=`{{ if .message }}{{ regexReplaceAll "[0-9a-f-]{36}" .message "…" }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{ if .model_id }}{{ .model_id }}{{ else }}{{ .catalog_id }}{{ end }}`

label_replace(max by (model_id, catalog, model) (atscale_model_info{env=~"$env"}), "key", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (catalog_id, catalog) (atscale_model_info{env=~"$env"}), "key", "$1", "catalog_id", "(.*)"), "model", "(not in the log line)", "", "")

panels.title: Why created: the query that asked for each new aggregate
panels.description: AtScale approves an aggregate candidate while it plans a user query that had no matching aggregate. Query ID is that query. Selection lists the attributes (dimension, key, measure) the aggregate holds. incidental = true: AtScale added the candidate while it planned another candidate.

targets.expr: $engine_selector |= "is approved" |= "Candidate" | regexp `queryId=(?P<query_id>[0-9a-f-]{36})` | regexp `Candidate (?P<aggregate_id>[0-9a-f-]{36}) is approved \(incidental=(?P<incidental>\w+).*?selection=(?P<selection>.*)\)$` | label_format selection=`{{ regexReplaceAll "AggregateDefinitionAttribute\\(([^,]*),(\\w+),(?:Some\\(\\w+\\)|None),\\w+\\)" .selection "$1 ($2)" }}`

panels.title: Why AtScale did not propose or rejected an aggregate (engine database)

options.content: AtScale runs prediction rules for each part of a user query that no aggregate answers. A **G** code means the rule proposed no aggregate. An **R** code means AtScale proposed a candidate and then rejected it. AtScale stores these decisions in its database; select the instance's database in **Engine database** at the top. Routine codes (G260, G270, G300, and G250 for preferred store copies) only say that a path does not apply. They appear on almost every query, so they are hidden unless **Routine codes** is set to show.

panels.title: Query parts predicted
panels.description: Query parts that went through aggregate prediction in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from engine.queries q join engine.aggregate_prediction_reports r on r.query_id = q.query_id left join engine.queries_planned qp on qp.query_id = q.query_id where r.report_type = 'approved' and $__timeFilter(q.received) and ('${catalog:regex}' = '.*' or qp.project_id::text ~ '^(${catalog_id:regex})$') and ('${model:regex}' = '.*' or qp.cube_id::text ~ '^(${model_id:regex})$')

panels.title: With an aggregate proposed
panels.description: Query parts for which at least one candidate passed all rules. AtScale then builds it.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from engine.queries q join engine.aggregate_prediction_reports r on r.query_id = q.query_id left join engine.queries_planned qp on qp.query_id = q.query_id where r.report_type = 'approved' and $__timeFilter(q.received) and ('${catalog:regex}' = '.*' or qp.project_id::text ~ '^(${catalog_id:regex})$') and ('${model:regex}' = '.*' or qp.cube_id::text ~ '^(${model_id:regex})$') and json_array_length(r.content->'approvedCandidates') > 0

panels.title: Not proposed (G)
panels.description: Query parts with at least one G code, without routine codes unless they are shown.

panels.title: Active aggregates
panels.description: One row per active aggregate. Created: when AtScale created the definition. Last build: when the build of the active table finished. Queries: how many queries used it (AtScale queryUtilization).

targets.expr: max by (env, catalog, model, aggregate_id, aggregate, subtype, table) (atscale_aggregate_created_timestamp_seconds{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"}) * 1000
max by (env, catalog, model, aggregate_id, aggregate, subtype, table) (atscale_aggregate_built_timestamp_seconds{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"}) * 1000
max by (env, catalog, model, aggregate_id, aggregate, subtype, table) (atscale_aggregate_build_duration_seconds{env=~"$env",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model"})
